changes.rationale: Link the maintained LORKHAN core and authenticated Beast transport into openmw-lib.
Expose typed session, turn, polling, cancellation, verified media playback, and status operations without generic host capabilities.
Declare the context-gated LORKHAN package initializers.
Expose openmw.lorkhan only through GLOBAL and local package maps; PLAYER/CUSTOM inherit local while MENU/LOAD do not.
Permit existing per-script package-loader semantics in script containers so openmw.lorkhan can be gated to CUSTOM local scripts.
Declare the engine-internal verified LORKHAN media stream playback seam without exposing host paths to Lua.
Decode an already verified native media stream so runtime downloads do not depend on the startup VFS index.
Declare the verified stream decoder entry point used only by the LORKHAN sound seam.
Play verified LORKHAN streams through the existing actor-positioned voice and lip-animation path with observable failure.
Implement the engine-internal verified LORKHAN media stream playback contract.
Let the LORKHAN compatibility Mod Manager load an additional OpenMW configuration directory from its command line.
Forward the compatibility Mod Manager's active configuration paths when it launches OpenMW.
Expose engine-expanded dialogue response text to player-local Lua events so TTS matches the visible dialogue window.
Capture successful actor spell casts as bounded session-fenced LORKHAN Lua observations.
